title: Perca di Atas Meja
genre: 1960s Melayu film-song orkes with tabla and mandolin
subject: Bu Nia, a village tailor, sews the leftover scraps of every customer's order into one patchwork cover on her counter, and Pak Hadi keeps asking her to move his red square next to the white lace square of the widow Bu Lastri
caption: 1960s Melayu film-song orkes, Hindi-film-tinged swaying dance rhythm. Tabla playing a light rolling groove, fast tremolo mandolin melody, drone-and-chord harmonium, unison violin section with sliding phrases, plucked acoustic bass. Warm mono-style studio recording, tape saturation, short spring reverb. Female vocal, mid-high register, coy playful delivery with gentle ornaments, clearly sung melody. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 108 BPM, A minor. Coy, comic, swaying mood. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no synths, no autotune, no rap, no modern dangdut gloss.
lyrics:
[Intro - tabla, mandolin, violins]

[Verse 1]
Sisa kain kusimpan di dalam laci
Merah punya Pak Hadi, biru Bu Ina
Kujahit semua jadi selimut di meja
Orang datang mencari kotaknya sendiri

[Pre-Chorus]
Pak Hadi bawa baju minta dijahit
Matanya tak lepas dari renda

[Chorus]
Pindahkan, Bu Nia, pindahkan sedikit
Kotak merahku dekat renda putih
Aduh, Pak, benang sudah terlanjur
Tapi untuk Bapak, kubuka jahitan

[Verse 2]
Bu Lastri datang mengambil kebaya
Rendanya dulu dari baju lamanya
Dia tengok selimut, lalu tersenyum
Pura-pura tak lihat siapa di sebelah

[Pre-Chorus]
Sebulan kemudian mereka datang berdua
Minta dijahitkan satu kotak lagi

[Chorus]
Pindahkan, Bu Nia, ke sini saja
Kotak merah dan renda putih
Tak usah dibongkar, sudah berdampingan
Kali ini jarumku yang berhenti

[Bridge - violins and tabla]
Jarum naik turun, benang menurut
Siapa menyangka perca bisa menjodohkan

[Chorus]
Pindahkan, Bu Nia, tidak usah lagi
Kotak merah dan renda putih
Sudah rapat sampai ke pinggiran
Kini kuberi kotak untuk kalian berdua

[Outro - mandolin, violins fade]
